mascot_generated.prompt: Illustrated brand mascot for B.B. Roofing & Exteriors, a veteran-owned roofing contractor in Spring, TX. Subject: a stylized eagle perched on a small roof peak, holding a gold laurel wreath in its beak — matches the brand's existing gold laurel-wreath logo motif. Front-facing pose, slightly heroic stance, neutral expression. Style: clean illustrated vector with a subtle line-art / etched-medal feel (NOT cartoon-childish, NOT photorealistic, NOT 3D-stock). Color palette: warm gold (#C2A74B) primary, deep dark (#1E1E22) outline + accents, white (#FFFFFF) negative space. Background: TRANSPARENT. Suitable as 64-110px corner stamp on white card. NO text. NO realistic feathers (illustrated only). Tone: dignified premium, military-veteran reverence (laurel wreath = victory + service).
mascot_generated.notes: Path B mascot generated per design-system/rules/mascot-generation-prompt-recipe.md. Used in 3 placements: owner-story bracket companion (line 2208), service-area SA2 feature (line 2319), footer brand stamp (line 2358). Cap 3-6 (mascot-rules.md §The cap).

_list.discovery_evidence: Firecrawl SERP for query '"Brandon Yniguez" "B.B. Roofing"' returned this FB post; the post caption explicitly names 'my Nephew Brandon Yniguez' AND 'B.B. Roofing & Exteriors, LLC' in close proximity; identity match is confirmed by the post text. The image itself (1080x1920 JPG) is a video frame from Brandon's TikTok-style content (visible captions 'thousands of dollars' baked in, eyes-closed mid-speech expression).
_list.confidence_reason: Identity match is high (post explicitly names Brandon + brand). Image quality for hero use is LOW: yellow caption text 'thousands of dollars' is baked into the frame and cannot be removed; the subject's eyes are closed mid-speech; pose is a video still, not a portrait. Stage 4 build should consider Path C (drop the .hero-owner-overlay layer) per sops/asset-scrape.md §2 Path A→B→C cascade. Operator can manually upload a cleaner Brandon portrait to override.
_list.claim_attached: Owner Brandon Yniguez (Managing Member, BBB Accredited 12/12/2024)

_list.source: remove-bg.sh transformation of assets/team/brandon-yniguez-portrait.jpg (provider: remove.bg API)
_list.discovery_evidence: remove.bg API processed the portrait JPG to a 375x666 RGBA PNG with transparent background; identity preserved (non-generative); the yellow caption text 'thousands of dollars' was retained in the cutout because it overlaps the subject's hands and is treated as foreground.
_list.confidence_reason: Same identity-confidence as the source portrait (low). Cutout is technically valid (transparent BG, alpha channel present) but inherits the source-image quality issues (caption overlay, eyes-closed pose).

absent_assets.reason_absent: No clean owner portrait found via Path A1 (source site has zero owner/team photos), Path A2 (Facebook business page is gated), Path A3 (Firecrawl SERP returned only one identifiable Brandon photo and it's a video frame with caption overlay + closed-eyes pose). Path A4 manual upload recommended for hero overlay use. Stage 4 Path C drop is currently the safest option.

Source site has no /team page and no team-grid section. The brand mentions partner Jordan Hilliard via Facebook posts (SERP-discovered), but no photos are attached to the live site. Skip the team-grid section in the build.
Source site has zero branded-truck or work-vehicle photos. Pattern 002 hero truck-cutout layer should be DROPPED (set design-profile.json#hero.truck_layer = false).

Source site does not display GAF / Owens Corning / CertainTeed / IKO badges. One SERP-discovered Facebook customer post mentions a 'Complete GAF Roofing System install' (suggests GAF-certified installation), but B.B. Roofing has not posted a manufacturer certification badge on its own site. Cannot claim GAF Master Elite / Owens Corning Platinum without proof — DO NOT add these badges to the build.

Texas does not require a state-level roofing contractor license; the site does not display a city license number. BBB profile lists no license. Footer should attribute to BBB Accredited + Veteran Owned only.
